title: Why GPS Needs Einstein or It Drifts 10 km a Day
description:
GPS satellite clocks run fast because gravity is weaker 20,000 km up, and without relativity corrections your position would drift about 10 km a day.

The map, pin drift and distance counter are illustrative, not to scale. The 20,000 km orbit height is approximate (real GPS orbits are about 20,200 km).

Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
